index ed08f72cdc..eb3c99209a 100644
--- a/libavcodec/riscv/vp8dsp_rvv.S
+++ b/libavcodec/riscv/vp8dsp_rvv.S
@@ -556,3 +556,581 @@ epel_hv \len 6 4
 epel_hv \len 4 6

 .endr
+
+/* VP8 loop filters (16 columns / 8 rows), vectorized.
+ * C reference: vp8dsp.c (vp8_filter_common / vp8_normal_limit / hev)
+ * filter_common (vp8, IS_VP8):
+ *   a = 3*(q0-p0); if (is4tap) a += clip_int8(p1-q1); a = clip_int8(a)
+ *   f1 = FFMIN(a+4, 127)>>3; f2 = FFMIN(a+3, 127)>>3
+ *   p[-1] = cm[p0+f2]; p[0] = cm[q0-f1]
+ *   if (!is4tap) { a=(f1+1)>>1; p[-2]=cm[p1+a]; p[1]=cm[q1-a] }
+ * normal_limit: 2*|p0-q0| + (|p1-q1|>>1) <= E && all |pn-pm|<=I
+ * hev: |p1-p0| > thresh || |q1-q0| > thresh
+ */
+
+/* e16 abs difference: vd = |vsa - vsb| (uses v28) */
+.macro vp8_absdiff16 vd, vsa, vsb
+        vsub.vv        \vd, \vsa, \vsb
+        vneg.v         v28, \vd
+        vmax.vv        \vd, \vd, v28
+.endm
+
+/* clip signed e16 to [-128,127] in place (uses t5) */
+.macro vp8_clip_i8 v
+        li      t5, -128
+        vmax.vx        \v, \v, t5
+        li      t5, 127
+        vmin.vx        \v, \v, t5
+.endm
+
+/* vp8_filter_common vector core on 16 columns (e16 domain).
+ * In:  v2..v9 = e16 p3,p2,p1,p0,q0,q1,q2,q3
+ *      v10 = normal mask, v11 = hev mask (e16, 0/-1)
+ * Out: v2..v9 updated pixels (e16). vxrm=0.
+ */
+.macro vp8_filter_common_vec
+        li      t5, 3
+        vsub.vv v12, v6, v5          /* q0-p0 */
+        vmul.vx v12, v12, t5
+        vsub.vv v13, v4, v3          /* p1-q1 */
+        vp8_clip_i8 v13
+        vadd.vv v12, v12, v13        /* a4 */
+        vp8_clip_i8 v12
+        vsub.vv v14, v6, v5
+        vmul.vx v14, v14, t5
+        vp8_clip_i8 v14              /* a8 */
+        li      t5, 127
+        vadd.vi v15, v12, 4
+        vmin.vx v15, v15, t5
+        vsra.vi v15, v15, 3          /* f1_4 */
+        vadd.vi v16, v12, 3
+        vmin.vx v16, v16, t5
+        vsra.vi v16, v16, 3          /* f2_4 */
+        vadd.vi v17, v14, 4
+        vmin.vx v17, v17, t5
+        vsra.vi v17, v17, 3          /* f1_8 */
+        vadd.vi v18, v14, 3
+        vmin.vx v18, v18, t5
+        vsra.vi v18, v18, 3          /* f2_8 */
+        vadd.vv v19, v5, v16         /* p0'4 */
+        vsub.vv v20, v6, v15         /* q0'4 */
+        vadd.vv v21, v5, v18         /* p0'8 */
+        vsub.vv v22, v6, v17         /* q0'8 */
+        vadd.vi v23, v17, 1
+        vsra.vi v23, v23, 1          /* a2 */
+        vadd.vv v24, v3, v23         /* p1'8 */
+        vsub.vv v25, v4, v23         /* q1'8 */
+        /* arithmetic select: r = b ^ ((a ^ b) & mask)  => mask ? a : b */
+        vxor.vv v26, v21, v19
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v11
+        vxor.vv v19, v19, v26          /* p0' = hev ? 4tap : 8tap */
+        vxor.vv v26, v22, v20
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v11
+        vxor.vv v20, v20, v26          /* q0' */
+        vxor.vv v26, v19, v5
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v10
+        vxor.vv v5, v5, v26            /* p0 = normal ? p0' : p0 */
+        vxor.vv v26, v20, v6
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v10
+        vxor.vv v6, v6, v26            /* q0 */
+        vxor.vv v26, v3, v24
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v11
+        vxor.vv v24, v24, v26          /* p1 = hev ? orig : 8tap */
+        vxor.vv v26, v4, v25
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v11
+        vxor.vv v25, v25, v26          /* q1 */
+        vxor.vv v26, v3, v24
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v10
+        vxor.vv v3, v3, v26            /* p1 = normal ? sel : orig */
+        vxor.vv v26, v4, v25
+        vand.vv v26, v26, v10
+        vxor.vv v4, v4, v26            /* q1 */
+.endm
+
+/* load 8 e8 rows (16 cols each) for vertical filtering, widen to e16 v2..v9
+ * a0 = dst (top-left of edge), a1 = stride */
+.macro vp8_load_v16
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e8, mf2, ta, ma
+        li      t5, 4
+        mul     t5, t5, a1
+        sub     t6, a0, t5           /* dst - 4*stride */
+        vle8.v  v10, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v11, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v12, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v13, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v14, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v15, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v16, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vle8.v  v17, (t6)
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v2, v10
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v3, v11
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v4, v12
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v5, v13
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v6, v14
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v7, v15
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v8, v16
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v9, v17
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e16, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+/* store v2..v9 (e16) back as e8 rows for vertical filtering */
+.macro vp8_store_v16
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vnsrl.wi        v10, v2, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v11, v3, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v12, v4, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v13, v5, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v14, v6, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v15, v7, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v16, v8, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v17, v9, 0
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e8, mf2, ta, ma
+        li      t5, 4
+        mul     t5, t5, a1
+        sub     t6, a0, t5
+        vse8.v  v10, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v11, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v12, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v13, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v14, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v15, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v16, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a1
+        vse8.v  v17, (t6)
+.endm
+
+/* compute normal mask (v10) and hev mask (v11) on e16 v2..v9.
+ * a2=E a3=I a4=hev_thresh */
+.macro vp8_masks16 Ereg, Ireg, Treg
+        vp8_absdiff16  v18, v2, v3     /* |p3-p2| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v19, v3, v4     /* |p2-p1| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v20, v4, v5     /* |p1-p0| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v21, v9, v8     /* |q3-q2| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v22, v8, v7     /* |q2-q1| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v23, v7, v6     /* |q1-q0| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v24, v5, v6     /* |p0-q0| */
+        vp8_absdiff16  v25, v4, v7     /* |p1-q1| */
+        vmsleu.vx       v10, v18, \Ireg
+        vmsleu.vx       v26, v19, \Ireg
+        vand.vv         v10, v10, v26
+        vmsleu.vx       v26, v20, \Ireg
+        vand.vv         v10, v10, v26
+        vmsleu.vx       v26, v21, \Ireg
+        vand.vv         v10, v10, v26
+        vmsleu.vx       v26, v22, \Ireg
+        vand.vv         v10, v10, v26
+        vmsleu.vx       v26, v23, \Ireg
+        vand.vv         v10, v10, v26
+        /* simple_limit: 2*|p0-q0| + (|p1-q1|>>1) <= E */
+        vsrl.vi         v25, v25, 1
+        vadd.vv         v24, v24, v24
+        vadd.vv         v24, v24, v25
+        vmsleu.vx       v26, v24, \Ereg
+        vand.vv         v10, v10, v26
+        /* hev: |p1-p0| > thresh || |q1-q0| > thresh */
+        vmsgtu.vx       v11, v20, \Treg
+        vmsgtu.vx       v26, v23, \Treg
+        vor.vv          v11, v11, v26
+.endm
+
+/* vp8_v_loop_filter16y_inner: a0=dst a1=stride a2=E a3=I a4=thresh */
+func ff_vp8_v_loop_filter16_inner_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        csrwi           vxrm, 0
+        vp8_load_v16
+        vp8_masks16  a2, a3, a4
+        vp8_filter_common_vec
+        vp8_store_v16
+        ret
+endfunc
+
+/* filter_mbedge vector core (e16 v2..v9, masks v10 normal / v11 hev).
+ *   w = clip_i8(clip_i8(p1-q1) + 3*(q0-p0))
+ *   a0 = (27*w+63)>>7; a1 = (18*w+63)>>7; a2 = (9*w+63)>>7
+ *   p2'=p2+a2 p1'=p1+a1 p0'=p0+a0 q0'=q0-a0 q1'=q1-a1 q2'=q2-a2
+ * 4tap (hev) only updates p0/q0. Temp vectors v24..v27, v29..v31.
+ */
+.macro vp8_filter_mbedge_vec
+        li      t5, 3
+        vsub.vv v12, v4, v7          /* p1-q1 */
+        vp8_clip_i8 v12
+        vsub.vv v13, v6, v5
+        vmul.vx v13, v13, t5
+        vadd.vv v12, v12, v13
+        vp8_clip_i8 v12               /* w */
+        li      t5, 27
+        vmul.vx v13, v12, t5
+        li      t5, 63
+        vadd.vx v13, v13, t5
+        vsra.vi v13, v13, 7           /* a0 */
+        li      t5, 18
+        vmul.vx v14, v12, t5
+        li      t5, 63
+        vadd.vx v14, v14, t5
+        vsra.vi v14, v14, 7           /* a1 */
+        li      t5, 9
+        vmul.vx v15, v12, t5
+        li      t5, 63
+        vadd.vx v15, v15, t5
+        vsra.vi v15, v15, 7           /* a2 */
+        vadd.vv v16, v2, v15          /* p2' */
+        vadd.vv v17, v3, v14          /* p1' */
+        vadd.vv v18, v5, v13          /* p0' */
+        vsub.vv v19, v6, v13          /* q0' */
+        vsub.vv v20, v7, v14          /* q1' */
+        vsub.vv v21, v8, v15          /* q2' */
+        /* 4tap p0/q0 */
+        li      t5, 3
+        vsub.vv v22, v6, v5
+        vmul.vx v22, v22, t5
+        vsub.vv v23, v4, v7
+        vp8_clip_i8 v23
+        vadd.vv v22, v22, v23
+        vp8_clip_i8 v22               /* a4 */
+        li      t5, 127
+        vadd.vi v24, v22, 4
+        vmin.vx v24, v24, t5
+        vsra.vi v24, v24, 3           /* f1 */
+        vadd.vi v25, v22, 3
+        vmin.vx v25, v25, t5
+        vsra.vi v25, v25, 3           /* f2 */
+        vadd.vv v26, v5, v25          /* p0'4 */
+        vsub.vv v27, v6, v24          /* q0'4 */
+        /* p0/q0 = hev ? 4tap : mbedge */
+        vxor.vv v29, v26, v18
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v11
+        vxor.vv v18, v18, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v27, v19
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v11
+        vxor.vv v19, v19, v29
+        /* p1/p2/q1/q2 = hev ? orig : mbedge */
+        vxor.vv v29, v3, v17
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v11
+        vxor.vv v17, v17, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v7, v20
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v11
+        vxor.vv v20, v20, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v2, v16
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v11
+        vxor.vv v16, v16, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v8, v21
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v11
+        vxor.vv v21, v21, v29
+        /* apply normal mask (v10) */
+        vxor.vv v29, v18, v5
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v10
+        vxor.vv v5, v5, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v19, v6
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v10
+        vxor.vv v6, v6, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v17, v3
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v10
+        vxor.vv v3, v3, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v20, v7
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v10
+        vxor.vv v7, v7, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v16, v2
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v10
+        vxor.vv v2, v2, v29
+        vxor.vv v29, v21, v8
+        vand.vv v29, v29, v10
+        vxor.vv v8, v8, v29
+.endm
+
+
+/* load 8 e8 rows (16 cols) with stride for horizontal filtering, e16 v2..v9
+ * a0 = dst (row 0 edge), a1 = stride */
+.macro vp8_load_h16
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e8, mf2, ta, ma
+        addi    t6, a0, -4
+        vlse8.v v10, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v11, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v12, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v13, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v14, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v15, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v16, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vlse8.v v17, (t6), a1
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v2, v10
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v3, v11
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v4, v12
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v5, v13
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v6, v14
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v7, v15
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v8, v16
+        vwcvt.x.x.v     v9, v17
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e16, m1, ta, ma
+.endm
+
+.macro vp8_store_h16
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e16, m1, ta, ma
+        vnsrl.wi        v10, v2, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v11, v3, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v12, v4, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v13, v5, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v14, v6, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v15, v7, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v16, v8, 0
+        vnsrl.wi        v17, v9, 0
+        vsetivli        zero, 16, e8, mf2, ta, ma
+        addi    t6, a0, -4
+        vsse8.v v10, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v11, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v12, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v13, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v14, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v15, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v16, (t6), a1
+        addi    t6, t6, 1
+        vsse8.v v17, (t6), a1
+.endm
+
+func ff_vp8_h_loop_filter16_inner_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        csrwi           vxrm, 0
+        vp8_load_h16
+        vp8_masks16  a2, a3, a4
+        vp8_filter_common_vec
+        vp8_store_h16
+        ret
+endfunc
+
+func ff_vp8_v_loop_filter16_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        csrwi           vxrm, 0
+        vp8_load_v16
+        vp8_masks16  a2, a3, a4
+        vp8_filter_mbedge_vec
+        vp8_store_v16

+endfunc
+
+func ff_vp8_h_loop_filter16_rvv, zve32x
+        lpad    0
+        csrwi           vxrm, 0
+        vp8_load_h16
+        vp8_masks16  a2, a3, a4
+        vp8_filter_mbedge_vec
+        vp8_store_h16
+        ret
+endfunc
+
+/* 8-column variants (8uv: U and V planes each filtered on 8 columns).
+ * a0=dstU a1=dstV a2=stride a3=E a4=I a5=hev_thresh (6 args).
+ * vl=8 (e8 mf4 / e16 mf2).
+ */
+.macro vp8_load_v8
+        vsetivli        zero, 8, e8, mf4, ta, ma
+        li      t5, 4
+        mul     t5, t5, a2
+        sub     t6, a0, t5
+        vle8.v  v10, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a2
+        vle8.v  v11, (t6)
+        add     t6, t6, a2
+        vle8.v  v12, (t6)
